title: [BE] Improve Purchase Ledger report performance
summary: The Belgian Purchase Ledger report now uses a single left-joined query with temporary buffering instead of per-entry lookups to reduce database calls and improve performance.
key_points: Replaces multiple per-entry VAT link queries and VAT Entry.Get calls with one left-joined query per journal template and period
Introduces an internal temporary buffer table and query to aggregate results
Filters on G/L entry dates rather than VAT entry dates to avoid filtering assumptions
Uses SetLoadFields and SetAutoCalcFields optimizations for supporting lookups
Maintains existing error handling and currency display behavior
quote: Reduce database overhead in the Belgian Purchase Ledger report (11301).
